facts.text: Audrey gave her dogs something special that includes a leash and shoes, which they find amusing but functional.

evidence.quote: Definitely! Safety is super important for me. I even got them something special. They sure look funny, but it works!

facts.text: Audrey and her dogs engage in playing fetch with a ball or frisbee during walks, which the dogs enjoy chasing.

evidence.quote: When I take them out, we usually play fetch with a ball or frisbee. They love chasing it!

facts.text: Audrey and her dogs meet other dog owners in the park for doggie playdates, which allows for social interaction and friendship-building.

evidence.quote: We also meet other dog owners in the park and have a doggie playdate. It's a great way for me to chat with people and for them to make new friends.

facts.text: Audrey's dogs are excited about playing fetch and show enthusiasm when Audrey brings out the items they enjoy.

evidence.quote: They absolutely adore it! They have tons of energy and love meeting new pals at playdates. Plus, they always get excited when I bring those out.
